event_chain.summary: Digital platforms disrupted; branches operate manually

summary: In early June 2026 South African funeral insurer AVBOB confirmed that external malicious actors had caused a cyber incident that disrupted its digital platforms and services. Some systems and branch services remained affected, and branches switched to manual procedures for payments, claims and funeral arrangements while technical teams and specialist partners worked to restore functionality. AVBOB was investigating whether personal information had been affected.
